description: A 6 x 6 m open meditation pavilion on nine posts, on the lower half of the plot. No walls, no earthworks - it floats over ground that drops 2.74 m beneath it. Low and wide rather than tall: the height limit measured from the low corner leaves only 2.91 m above the deck, so the roof is shallow. That suits it - a platform 3 m in the air looking at the sunset does not want a tall roof.

position.note: local frame from P5; see koh-phangan-land

deck_rule: highest corner plus 0.35 m, so the deck is level

roof.constraint: the 6 m is measured from the LOW corner, so post height and roof height compete

why_not_on_the_rock: the main ledge is only about 3 m wide
